content: gRPC streaming pitfalls: HTTP/2 flow control applies to streams (not unary); a slow Watch client fills its window and SendMsg blocks - if fan-out shares a goroutine/mutex this head-of-line blocks ALL subscribers. Fixes: per-subscriber buffered channel with drop-or-timeout send semantics, dedicated sender goroutine per stream, detect and kill stuck consumers (etcd/K8s watch do this). Keepalive: servers by default permit client pings only every 5min - more frequent pings without streams trigger GOAWAY ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM too_many_pings; enable server-side keepalive (keepalive.ServerParameters Time/Timeout) so dead clients (silent death, no RST) are detected and streams released; mismatched client/server keepalive configs are the most common gRPC incident class.
